common: Art direction concept for Monster Mash, an original mobile folklore MOBA. Portrait 9:16 game view, elevated orthographic 3D camera tilted down 45 degrees, no horizon. The main cobblestone lane runs perfectly vertically from bottom center to top center, never diagonally. A friendly but formidable green Loch Ness monster champion with a long curved neck, four flippers and a teal fin stands at bottom center, seen from behind and above. Three little blue spirit minions march ahead toward a violet crystalline ward tower at top center. A quaint haunted village with crooked roof cottages occupies the left side; dense pines, ancient mossy stones and foggy deep woods occupy the right side. A narrow luminous cyan creek crosses horizontally at the middle with a stone bridge. Large clear traversable spaces, readable silhouettes, richly detailed surroundings. Dusk lighting, warm golden lanterns versus cool blue woodland haze. Mobile HUD integrated cleanly: small circular minimap in upper right, translucent joystick in lower left, exactly three circular special ability icons in a thumb arc at lower right, compact gold counter and item slots along the bottom. No attack button. No phone frame, no logos, no existing franchise characters. Show a polished aspirational gameplay screenshot, not a character portrait or promotional poster.

styles.ghibli: Studio Ghibli inspired art direction: beautifully hand-painted watercolor and gouache scenery, lush layered greens, warm sunlight, soft cel shading over dimensional forms, whimsical folklore creatures, delicate brushwork in the clouds and trees, textured stone, enchanting quiet wonder. Maintain strong depth and the elevated game camera.
styles.pixar: Pixar inspired feature animation art direction: fully dimensional sculpted 3D forms, appealing chunky silhouettes, expressive original monster design, tactile stylized materials, soft global illumination, cinematic rim lighting, rich ambient occlusion, beautifully rendered water and foliage. Avoid flat illustration; make every creature and building feel like a carefully crafted animated movie asset.
styles.rick-and-morty: Rick and Morty inspired adult animated science-fiction art direction: crisp bold black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, acid green and ultraviolet accents, strange goofy folklore beasts with expressive eyes, warped crooked architecture and eccentric otherworldly plants. Preserve the dimensional elevated game view, vertical lane and gameplay readability. Original creatures only, no recognizable franchise characters.
